Story and tutorial on next new game
Every washing machine has a secret.
Somewhere between the spin cycle and the dryer, one sock always slips away. You have seen it happen. Everyone has.
They tumble through a tiny fold in the fabric of laundry and land in the Sock Dimension, a place made of nothing but odd socks.
Thousands of them. Striped, dotted, ankle-short and knee-high. Each one alone, each one waiting for its twin.
Tonight, the fold opened inside your washing machine.
A few socks have already slipped out onto the lid. Something much bigger is still rumbling in the drum.
Match each sock with its twin and the two roll up and hop into the laundry basket. Start with the pairs on the washing machine.
Click or Space to continue  ·  Esc to skip

Hold F to bring the sock close and turn it with the mouse. Twins share colour, pattern, stripes and shape.
Right-click to throw the sock in your hand. Left-click on empty space just drops it.
Hold one sock, aim at its twin and press E. A match rolls up and flies into the basket.
Those two only look alike. Check colour, pattern, stripes and length, then try again.
